grandparents_cupboard.reason: Flour, oats, bicarb, sugar, vinegar, oil and fresh apricots are all plain cupboard and fruit-bowl staples.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday item in Tesco, and apricots are on shelves in June.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a bowl, a whisk, a baking tray and an oven, and shaping a soda bread round is well within a beginner's reach.

works.reason: About 410ml of liquid to 500g of dry mix, with vinegar to activate 1 tsp bicarb, gives a soft dough, and 35 to 40 minutes at 200°C with a hollow-sound test suits a loaf of this size.

honest_times.reason: Fifteen minutes covers stoning and chopping five apricots and mixing, and the 40-minute cook matches the bake time in the steps.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used in the steps, the names match their ids, and only water is added.

seasonal_feel.reason: Fresh apricots are in season in late June and are the named fruit running through the loaf.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear British English with a practical doneness test and no restaurant language.

hearty_healthy.reason: A mostly wholemeal and oat loaf with fresh fruit and only 2 tbsp sugar makes a filling, wholesome afternoon snack.
